notablePrerequisites: Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Morphling.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Incubation Druid.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Incubation Druid's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.
